candidate_tasks.title: Order-zero quadratic-form comparison from EpsilonClose
candidate_tasks.proposed_Lean_statement_or_precise_contr: On a common manifold (intended instance: epsilonNeckDomain epsilon with EpsilonNeckCylinderModel), assume EpsilonClose epsilon g0 g. Then for every p and tangent v, |g.metricInner p v v - g0.metricInner p v v| <= Real.sqrt (metricCovariantDerivativeNormSq g0 g 0 p) * g0.metricInner p v v, and therefore g.metricInner p v v >= (1 - epsilon) * g0.metricInner p v v whenever the order-0 density is < epsilon^2 (which EpsilonClose supplies). Specialization: if S : EpsilonNeckStructure epsilon g x, the same comparison holds between S.normalizedPullbackMetric and S.referenceMetric. Do not assume IsRoundCylinderMetric, pinching, or a surgery cap. This is the source of the convention-corrected factor eta = 1 - delta used by radial nonexpansion, not a restatement of thm:local-neck-surgery.
missing_dependencies: A tensor-norm comparison |T(v,v)| <= |T|_{g0} |v|_{g0}^2 extracted from the orthonormal-frame contraction already used inside metricCovariantDerivativeNormSq (order 0). Orthonormal frames exist via Ch02/OrthoFrame exists_orthonormalFrame; that lemma was not re-parsed here as a completed proof.

candidate_tasks.title: Length-metric Lipschitz gluing of finitely many surgery pieces
candidate_tasks.proposed_Lean_statement_or_precise_contr: Abstract length-space form of blueprint lem:length-metric-gluing, independent of Ricci flow and of collars. Let X be a length space covered by finitely many closed pieces X_1,...,X_m whose pairwise overlaps are the common boundary spheres (or, weaker: any finite closed cover). Let F_i : X_i -> Y be L-Lipschitz for the induced length metric of X_i, and assume F_i = F_j on X_i intersect X_j. Then the glued map F : X -> Y is L-Lipschitz for the ambient metric of X. Do not conclude a global Lipschitz bound from boundary agreement alone; the proof must use path subdivision and the length-space property. Do not mention homotopy type, connected sums, or controlled surgery flows.
known_dependencies: Shared.LengthSpace (class: edist x y = inf pathLength)
missing_dependencies: If the intended consumer is a Riemannian 3-manifold after cutting along embedded two-spheres, the cut pieces as length spaces and the ambient Riemannian distance (MorganTianLib.canonicalMetricSpace) must be identified. That identification is not required to state or prove the abstract gluing lemma.
